Show transcript Storm Shield App 51.2K subscribers VideosAboutTwitterFacebookInstagram Show less El Niño vs. La Niña: What's the difference?185,426 views185K viewsFeb 17, 20161.5KShareSaveDownload Download 82 Comments Sort comments Sort by Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam Add a comment... @nicholas0963 6 years ago Not to mention also, that the ENSO cycle, also has an effect during Hurricane season. In a El Niño, The pacific ocean gets more hurricane activity due to less vertical wind shear, while the Atlantic ocean gets less hurricane activity due to stronger wind shear, stronger trade winds, and more atmospheric stability. In a La Niña, The Atlantic ocean gets more hurricane activity due to less vertical wind shear, weaker trade winds, and less atmospheric stability, while the pacific ocean gets less hurricane activity due to stronger wind shear.
